title: GamiBench: Evaluating Spatial Reasoning and 2D-to-3D Planning Capabilities of MLLMs with Origami Folding Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses in multiple-choice questions to observe tendencies to consistently favor specific answer option positions (e.g., "Option A") regardless of the actual content.

Analyzing incorrect model selections to determine if models preferentially choose shapes that are visually coherent and geometrically consistent, even when they are the wrong 3D transformation for the given crease pattern.
